summary: Frontend-only test of PhotoUploadChip on Anggota page. Chip visible for admin & petugas, toggles correctly with proper toasts, API /api/settings member_photo_upload stays in sync, Pengaturan photo-upload-switch/status mirrors the chip state, student portals (Siti profile shows photo-upload-locked; shared siswa shows photo-upload-locked-button) react correctly to Nonaktif. Mobile 390: chip stays on one line (white-space:nowrap, h=34). Final state left Aktif via petugas. Found one issue: mobile toolbar does not wrap and the primary 'Tambah anggota' button is cut off beyond the viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px width the toolbar buttons do NOT wrap. 'Tambah anggota' (data-testid=add-member-button) sits at x=372, right=421 (viewport=390), so it is clipped by ~31px. The task spec explicitly required: 'toolbar buttons wrap and are not cut off'. All four action buttons (Impor/Hapus massal/Naik kelas/Tambah anggota) are compressed to icon-only ~50px tiles on one row, with the primary overflowing to the right.

issues: Toolbar buttons squeezed to icon-only tiles and overflow horizontally instead of wrapping to a new row below the chip.

action_items: Make the Members .toolbar-buttons flex-wrap on mobile (<=480px) or stack them in a second row below the title+chip block so 'Tambah anggota' is not clipped at 390px width. Verify at exactly 390px: all four buttons visible (either wrapped or scrollable with visible edges).
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoUploadChip.js: clean, uses data-testid for chip & status, correct state mapping (member_photo_upload !== false). No code-level issues.
App.js Members toolbar: the primary action 'Tambah anggota' is still inside the same row as three secondary buttons; needs responsive wrap rule at narrow widths.
test_credentials: admin@smansa.sch.id/admin123, petugas@smansa.sch.id/petugas123, siti@smansa.sch.id/siti123, siswa@smansa.sch.id/siswa123 — all working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chip itself works end-to-end across admin/petugas/siswa flows and syncs with Pengaturan. Only remaining concern is mobile toolbar overflow at 390px (Tambah anggota clipped). Final state of member_photo_upload is TRUE (Aktif) via petugas.
rca of the issue: At 390px, .toolbar-buttons uses a non-wrapping flex row. With the chip added to the title column, the right-hand buttons column exceeds the remaining width, pushing 'Tambah anggota' past the viewport. Fix by adding flex-wrap:wrap (or stacking on a new row) in the mobile media query in Lanjutan.css for .toolbar / .toolbar-buttons.
